reference.title: A holo sticker on a notebook (a person's request); copies bar 10-foil-card

alive.rests: The sticker lies still on a still notebook page: nothing moves without the pointer, and foil colour never moves with the clock (as bar 10)

beats: A ruled notebook page with a margin line lies under one key light; a die-cut sticker sits on it, raised a little, with a white border, a lit edge and a shadow that falls away from the light
The sticker's face is holographic foil with sunburst grooves from one seeded point, so each ray angle shows its own colour from the grating and the colour turns round a printed star outline
Moving the pointer tilts the sticker and turns the key toward it: the foil's colour sweeps round the burst, and the lit edge and shadow follow the light
The sticker's word sits on a white under-print band and the note's title sits on the paper above the ruled lines, so both stay readable
Nothing moves without the pointer; when the pointer leaves the page the tilt eases back to flat
